headline: On November 23, 1992: IBM Simon introduced at COMDEX
captionCards: First smartphone with a touchscreen and PCMCIA slot
Pioneered the fusion of phone and PDA functions
instagramCaption:
The IBM Simon made its debut at COMDEX in Las Vegas.

It was the first device to combine a phone and PDA with a touchscreen.
Built on an x86 processor, it ran MS-DOS-compatible software.
Its PCMCIA slot allowed installing new apps—unlike any device before.
Today’s smartphones trace their roots to this 1994 release.
